name: Stella Hoshinomiya
source: A mysterious girl who lives in an abandoned lighthouse. She has a deep passion for reading, astronomy and the stars. Living in isolation and secluded from the townsfolk due to her eccentric behavior, she lives by herself and keeps her distance from others.
